newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan money rates seesaw to end high.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan money rates seesaw to end high.

text.p: Pakistan's money market rates fluctuated widely on Monday before ending high before the settlement of a central bank auction of short-term federal bonds (STFB) worth 19.9 billion rupees on Tuesday, dealers said.

"The real impact of the outflow of this huge amount from the system will be felt on Tuesday," one dealer said. "The inflow of about eight billion rupees, that is due tomorrow in the form of STFB maturity, now seems insignificent against this outflow."
The rates on Monday remained volatile from the opening in view of Tuesday's outflow, he said.
"Initial deals were made around 12 percent, but the rates dipped to 6.0 to 8.0 percent later," the dealer said. "Towards the close, they jumped back to 10 percent."
